goal.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: Lumo mobile banking Home Ask Lumo illustration, panoramic 2:1, 1774x887 pixels.
Input images: Image 1 and Image 2 are STYLE REFERENCES only: copy their very simple friendly flat cartoon drawing language, bold rounded black contour, playful elongated proportions, simple dot/line facial features, solid black/white shapes. Image 3 is COMPOSITION AND SCENE reference only, do not keep its semi-realistic rendering.
Primary request: Redraw the third campus scene as a decidedly cartoonish, graphic Minna-style illustration of two Ghanaian university friends discussing a savings goal while one holds a phone and a laptop rests on their knees.
Scene/backdrop: University of Ghana Legon, a very simplified Balme Library tower and palms, restrained in pale gray, not detailed architecture. The entire surface is one light neutral #f4f4f4 block.
Composition: Wide landscape 2:1. Keep the LEFT 42 percent entirely blank pale #f4f4f4 for real HTML question text added by the app later. Students, phone and simple library are only on right 58 percent, large enough to read in a 327x166 mobile card. Waist-up or seated cropped view, phone clearly visible at center of the student group and slightly turned so its screen faces viewer. All contours and object edges hard and simple.
Color palette: Strict black, white and neutral grays everywhere EXCEPT one small acid-lime #d7ff3f circular disk/ring ON THE PHONE SCREEN with a tiny black four-point sparkle centered inside it, an intelligence indicator. This phone circle should remain visible at small mobile display size. No other colored part, no lime clothing, no yellow or green background.
Style: Flat 2D expressive cartoon, chunky ink outlines and simple cheerful features like style references, not semi-realistic comic portrait, not anime, not photoreal, no gray airbrush shading, no engraving/hatching, no grain, no gradients or 3D. Minimal solid planar gray shading only.
Text: No text, no letters, no numbers, no speech bubble, no watermark. The live app will overlay its own accessible text onto the blank left area.
Constraints: seamless neutral background, no border or rounded panel or floating UI. Preserve Ghanaian student identity and recognisable simple Legon setting while greatly simplifying the faces and architecture.
